note: PREVIEW mapping of clause_id -> hand-reviewed one-sentence summary -> content hash (sha256) of that summary text. These summaries are human-reviewed paraphrases used to make a consent root_set_hash traceable to named clauses. They are NOT the authoritative encoding of the roots and NOT the hash of the root PDFs. The authoritative, sealed root documents (The Message / الرسالة, The Seed / البذرة, The Third Fact) live under docs/root-canon/source/ and are pinned by docs/root-canon/root-canon.manifest.json. This registry claims no live root-clause enforcement and no live governance.

clauses.summary: Every human being carries inherent dignity that no system, model, or authority may violate.
Mercy and peace are the default posture toward others, not exceptions granted only under pressure.
All people stand equal in worth; no lineage, wealth, or role confers superiority over another.
Each person is accountable for their actions beyond the reach of ego, status, or self-justification.
Ihsan means acting with excellence and conscience as if constantly seen, treating excellence as the minimum.
Participation is voluntary and every participant keeps the right to stop, withdraw, or refuse at any time.
The heart balances the mind; reason alone, unchecked by conscience, is not a sufficient guide.
Moderation and simplicity are preferred over excess, hoarding, and needless complexity.
Value must come from real contribution, never from riba or extraction that takes without earning.
Solidarity and social spending bind the community so that surplus flows toward those in need.
The human mission is central and the model is only a tool serving that mission, never its master.
Proof and explicit consent must precede any binding action; nothing binds on assumption alone.
